notes: Renders a native <input>, which edits its own value.

THE EDITING EVENT IS NOT THE SAME EVENT. React wires this to `onChange`, which is React's synthetic per-keystroke event and is NOT the DOM `change` event. Vue has no synthetic layer, so the DOM applies: `change` fires on blur and `input` fires per keystroke. The emitter wires `@input`. Two backends reading one contract reach different event names for the same sentence, and the contract is right not to name either.
